name: Yolanda W.
text: If you're looking for the old diner experience, this is the place. Staff was very friendly, they knew their regulars by name. The pancakes were top notch!!

name: Aleesha N.
text: The food was delicious, and our server, Joey, is a great guy. Everyone here is very nice, and the place is clean and welcoming.

name: Sierra H.
text: This is the best place I've been for breakfast. We had the absolute best waitress; she walked us through the menu. 10/10 recommend!

name: Marcie B.
text: Wow, what a hidden gem. The service here was Amazing! Thank you Lori!! The food tastes amazing and the prices are so reasonable.

name: Kenyen
text: Hands down the best breakfast in Springfield. My server was great. The Cox family gets 100 stars from me. Thank you!!

name: Abby
text: The most delicious homemade cinnamon raisin bread French toast, perfectly cooked bacon, and bottomless coffee! Lori was superb.

name: Stefanie F.
text: New to Springfield and looking for a Good Ol' Breakfast place - I found a gem. Eggs Benedict was amazing.

name: Collene E.
text: Truly great American diner. Delicious food, made from scratch, and plentiful. Kind, friendly waitstaff, quick service.

name: Walter H.
text: This is our go-to place for breakfast. There is a huge breakfast menu, and everything I've tried has been great.
